This graph shows the length of the growing season in the contiguous 48 states relative to the historical 50-year average. For each year, the line represents the number of days shorter or longer than average. The line was smoothed using an 11-year moving average. Historical observations are from 1895 through 2023. Modeled projections for four different climate scenarios are from 2015 through 2100. Historical model outputs are shown from 1950 to 2014. Modeled outputs are smoothed using an 11-year moving average. Shaded bands show the range of unsmoothed annual values from different climate models. Select items in the legend to toggle them on or off.
